jobs.title: Product Manager, Identity & Access Management
jobs.description_text: About the team IAM is the nerve center of Stripe. We control how millions of businesses grant access to their account, including employees, AI agents, apps, and API integrations, across the Dashboard, API, CLI, and MCP. We're also a platform team, building the unified, fine-grained permissions model that every product at Stripe builds on. AI agents are changing how businesses operate, and how they get authorized, governed, and secured is being defined right now—largely by us. We’re tackling challenging and unsolved problems for real businesses, like how to model agents when they blur the line between acting on behalf of a human vs. standalone principals, or how to authorize entire agent workflows rather than step-by-step actions. We’re collaborating directly with the frontier AI labs on the evolution of MCP, new identity protocols, and agent integrations. We build for solo founders and Fortune 500s alike, and the tension between those two is where the real product work lives. What you’ll do You'll set the vision and drive the roadmap for how every principal, human, agent, or app, gets access to a Stripe account. Companies selling across countries, states, and even smaller jurisdictions have to navigate through a myriad of tax rates, product-level tax exemptions, filing requirements, and registration obligations. The rules are constantly changing, and not accurately calculating and filing tax can have legal ramifications. It’s no surprise then that solving for tax compliance is a top user ask. We launched Stripe Tax as a new SaaS product in 2021 to help solve this pain point and make tax compliance as effortless as possible. jobs.title: Designer II, Innovation Footwear Design
jobs.description_text: Your Job: As a Brooks Designer II, Innovation Footwear Designer, you will execute with high design quality playing a key role in shaping the future of running footwear. You will drive innovation and elite athlete projects by delivering creative solutions to athlete-driven performance needs. You will work as part of a multidisciplinary innovation team focused on creating products that elevate athlete performance and fuel the future of the Brooks footwear pipeline, while also delivering the AESTHETIC READINESS of Brooks Running inline footwear product. In this role, you will execute the DESIGN VISION by collaborating with Senior Designers and cross-functional partners to translate early-stage innovation concepts into tangible footwear designs. You will design with empathy for Brooks ELITE ATHLETES and runners, informing next-generation platforms, tools, and product ideas through thoughtful execution and iteration. You will design within the creative foundation CRAFTED BEAUTY – PERFORMANCE EXPRESSIONS, to keep the connection to the runner’s experience across Fit, Feel, and Ride, while maintaining brand direction and appropriate aesthetic appeal for a targeted consumer. As a Designer II, Innovation Footwear Designer, you will partner closely with your teammates to bring idea and concept generation to support the innovation of shoe making methods and future manufacturing. In addition, you will work on projects in close partnership with the Advanced Research & Development Team ensu

jobs.title: Footwear Innovation Developer II, Racing Footwear
jobs.description_text: Your Job: The Footwear Innovation Developer II – Racing Footwear utilizes advanced, technical product and process knowledge, to work with a cross-functional product creation team from the collection of insights through commercialization to deliver the highest-performing racing footwear for Brooks professional athletes like the Beasts Track Club, Hansons-Brooks ODP, Mavericks, NIL athletes, and Brooks runners of all levels.. Your work has a direct impact on the Brooks professional athlete results, Brooks Sports Marketing strategy, and technology learnings that trickle into the full Brooks performance product line. You have successful hands-on experience and knowledge of the total footwear construction process including outsole/midsole technical 2D/ 3D, pattern engineering, material construction and properties, and costing. You understand, through curiosity, intuition, and direct feedback, the nuanced needs of elite track & road racing athletes and foresee innovation opportunities to equip them with revolutionary racing product. Other critical responsibilities include understanding manufacturing capabilities, anticipating issues, problem solving, and timely resolution. Your ideas around engineering principles that enhance product performance, product value, and your ability to communicate them across the product teams is a must for this role.

jobs.title: Footwear Product Developer, Asia
jobs.description_text: Your Job: The Footwear Product Developer, Asia will help drive our footwear development process from concept to commercialization with certain supervision and guidance from Senior Developer/ Development Manager. You will work with cross–functional and multi-national product creation teams to help support the development process between our US based team and our factories in China and Vietnam to meet model, commercialization and material development timelines. You will actively manage and engineer prototypes through to product confirmation while working directly with various product creation groups (Pattern Engineering, Asia Mold Shop, Sample Room, Costing, Materials, and Design Departments) to drive the tech package process and ensure products meet or exceed our quality standards. The Footwear Product Developer, Asia will be responsible for generating and communicating ideas regarding the engineering principles that enhance footwear performance and overall value to our products.

jobs.title: Senior Apparel Innovation Designer, Advanced
jobs.description_text: Your Job: As the Senior Apparel Innovation Designer, Advanced at Brooks, you will focus on creating innovative apparel solutions for projects 2-3 years out, bridging the gap between long-term developments and quick-to-market products. You will create advanced concepts, materials, and construction techniques that enhance performance and comfort for runners, with a strong emphasis on feasibility and readiness for commercialization. Your work will culminate in a structured handoff to the in-season design team, ensuring a smooth transition from concept to production. This role requires a self-starter and independent thinker able to lead Apparel Innovation Design in collaboration with Materials Innovation to drive innovation for Brooks Apparel.

jobs.description_text: 2009년 설립된 클로버추얼패션은 디지털 패션의 새로운 생태계를 만들어 가고 있습니다. 의상 디자인 소프트웨어 CLO, Marvelous Designer, Jinny 와 함께, CLO-SET, CONNECT와 같은 의상 콘텐츠에 특화된 플랫폼으로 의상의 모든 여정에 관여함으로써, 효율적이고 지속 가능한 워크플로우를 구축하고 있습니다. 뿐만 아니라, 당사 솔루션을 통해 실제 의상과 디지털 의상이 서로 태그되어 CLO 시스템 내에서 기능할 수 있게 합니다. 글로벌 디지털 패션 시장을 주도하고 있는 클로버추얼패션은 현재 아시아, 북미, 유럽, 남미 등 전 세계 13개국에 총 16개의 오피스를 두고 있으며, 세계 각국의 수많은 고객사를 바탕으로 점점 확장해나가고 있습니다.
